jobs.occupation: Receptionist - International Law Firm - Centre Brussels
jobs.description:
As a Receptionist, you will support the smooth day-to-day operations of an international law firm. You will combine front-desk responsibilities with administrative support, coordinate various office-related activities, and help ensure a professional experience for colleagues, visitors and business partners in a multicultural environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international law firm. With a strong reputation for excellence and a collaborative, multicultural environment, fostering a supportive and people-oriented workplace. There are located next to a metro and bus station and at walking distance from a train station.

 

Description

As a Receptionist you'll be responsible for:

• Manage the reception area and ensure a professional and welcoming experience for visitors.
• Answer and direct incoming phone calls.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, including scheduling, room setup, and catering arrangements.
• Oversee office supplies and maintain stock levels.
• Handle incoming and outgoing mail, and deliveries.
• Provide administrative support for document management, invoicing, and office-related processes.
• Support the wider office team with ad hoc administrative tasks and projects.

• First professional experience in reception, hospitality, customer service or administration is a plus.
• Excellent communication skills with a strong service-oriented mindset.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.
• Ability to multitask and remain organised in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word and Excel).
• Excellent spoken and written English and French; Dutch is a plus.

We are looking for an enthusiastic CNC miller for our production department. Our client develops and manufactures modular systems for the live communications sector. As a CNC miller, you will mill aluminum profiles according to drawings. You will alternate between batch production and custom work. In addition, you will use an ERP system to process production orders. You will also be responsible for creating milling programs, setting up the milling machine, loading and unloading the machine, and performing quality checks. Furthermore, you will perform first-line maintenance on the machine. 

• Experience as a CNC miller
• Ability to read blueprints and knowledge of using measuring instruments
• Quality-oriented, with a sense of order and neatness
• You are fluent in English
• Willing to work in a two-shift system
• Team player with a positive attitude

D-NETWORK is looking for a permanent IT Desktop/Web Platforms Manager, Engineering Manager for a customer based in Mechelen.

You're Fluent in English with

• Minimum 10 years of professional experience in software engineering, including significant time (at least 3 years) in engineering leadership or people-management roles.
• Proven experience leading teams delivering complex, long-lived production software where reliability, quality, and risk management are critical.
• An expertise in the medical device or healthcare industry sector is a big plus.
• Contract in CDI/ Permanent role/ Employee (no freelancer for this opportunity).
 

Position Overview :

The Engineering Manager (Desktop/Web Platforms) plays a pivotal leadership role in this transformation.

This role is a technical people-leadership and engineering accountability role.

It is not a Product Owner, Project Manager, Scrum Master, or Tech Lead role.

The Engineering Manager partners closely with Architecture, Tech Leads, DevOps, V&V, QA, Regulatory Affairs, Product, and Delivery Management to ensure teams deliver medical-grade software safely, predictably, and at scale.

 

The primary purpose of this role is to:

• Build and sustain high-performing engineering teams

• Ensure predictable, high-quality execution

• Strengthen engineering maturity and standards adoption

• Reduce delivery risk and technical ambiguity

• Ensure compliance Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory obligations

Profile / Requirements

• Master degree in Engineering /Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical & Computer Engineering.

• Demonstrated, senior-level experience leading engineering teams responsible for complex, long-lived, production software where failure has material business, safety, or regulatory consequences.

• Proven record of people leadership over execution: you build, scale, and correct teams through expectations, systems, and accountability—not by being the smartest engineer in the room.

• Unambiguous experience hiring, developing, and performance-managing engineers, including senior engineers and Tech Leads; comfortable making hard calls to protect team and product integrity.

• Sufficient technical depth to challenge architectural, quality, and delivery decisions credibly, without acting as the architect, Tech Lead, or primary implementer.

• Direct exposure to regulated, safety-critical, or audit-driven software environments; understands traceability, reproducibility, documentation, and compliance as first-class engineering concerns, not overhead.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver predictably in environments with conflicting priorities, incomplete information,

and regulatory constraints, using disciplined planning and risk management rather than optimism.

• Proven capability to operate in global, distributed organisations, aligning teams across sites, time zones, and cultures while maintaining consistent engineering standards.

• Strong executive judgment: able to make, explain, and defend difficult trade-offs that prioritise long-term engineering health, patient safety, and organisational credibility over short-term wins.

• Ability to represent engineering reality clearly and without dilution to Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders, including transparent communication of risks, constraints, and consequences.

• Demonstrated intolerance for weak engineering discipline, hero-driven execution, and ambiguity in ownership or decision-making

• High personal standards for integrity, accountability, and professionalism in a medical or safety-critical context.

• Excellent command of technical English; precise, concise, and credible in written and verbal communication.

• Willingness to travel as required to maintain alignment, trust, and execution across global teams.

• Advanced degree in Software Engineering or a closely related discipline, demonstrating depth in software design, systems thinking, and long-term technical decision-making.

• Demonstrated experience designing, evolving, or governing complex software architectures in regulated or safety-critical environments (medical devices strongly preferred), with clear understanding of design-for-quality, traceability, and auditability.

• Strong working knowledge of applicable medical-device or safety-critical regulations, with practical experience embedding compliance into everyday engineering practices rather than treating it as a downstream activity.

• Credible understanding of modern AI/ML concepts and their application boundaries, risks, and governance considerations in regulated software systems (not hands-on model building, but informed leadership and judgment).

 

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate future technology shifts and guide teams through adoption decisions responsibly, balancing innovation with safety, maintainability, and regulatory expectations.

• Build senior leadership judgment by owning engineering direction, quality posture, and delivery capability where compliance and reliability are mandatory.

• Operate at executive level, balancing technology, regulation, delivery risk, and long-term organisational health with Directors and VPs.

jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technologist - Sensors and Measurement Equipment
jobs.description:
• Manage equipment: Keep climate chambers, sensors, data loggers and other measurement equipment ready for use, and carry out checks, calibrations and preventive maintenance.
• Resolve technical issues: Troubleshoot practical technical problems and coordinate repairs with suppliers or technical services.
• Support experiments and measurement campaigns: Prepare equipment, connect sensors, start data collection and monitor measurement quality in the laboratory and on site.
• Guide users: Give researchers and students clear instructions on using equipment safely and correctly.
• Improve measurement setups: Build, test and improve setups together with researchers and technical partners.
• Maintain documentation, stock and safety: Keep technical records and stock inventories up to date, follow up on routine purchases and help maintain a safe and orderly laboratory environment.

• You hold a professional bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or scientific field, such as electromechanics, electronics and ICT, energy technology, biomedical laboratory technology or agricultural technology. Recent graduates and candidates with an equivalent level of competence gained through relevant experience are also eligible.
• Technical foundation: You enjoy hands-on work with equipment and have a basic knowledge of sensors, measurement systems, electronics or technical installations.
• Independent working: You take initiative, plan and document your work carefully, and take a focused approach to solving practical technical problems.
• Collaboration and support: You have a service-oriented approach and provide researchers and students with clear practical instructions.
• Safety and quality: You pay attention to safety, quality and good housekeeping in a laboratory environment.
• Flexibility: You are willing to travel for planned measurement campaigns and to further develop your skills in digital measurement systems and automated data collection.
• Languages and software: You communicate in Dutch and English, or are willing to further develop your proficiency in one of these languages, and you are familiar with Microsoft Office Experience in one or more of the following areas is an asset, but is not required: 

• Measuring environmental factors such as temperature, humidity, air velocity, air quality or energy consumption; 
• Physiological measurement equipment, climate control installations, building management systems or connected sensors;
• Digital data collection or software such as LabVIEW, MATLAB or Python.

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Life Sciences Transformation - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium (Hybrid)

• Contract: 12-Month Initial Contract (Extension Likely)

• Language: English

• Start Date: December

• Industry: Life Sciences / Healthcare

• Engagement: Freelance

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.
IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.
Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.
IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
